cases.case_label: De novo full-length antisense SVA in exon 13 of SRCAP
cases.disease: SRCAP-related neurodevelopmental disorder (failure to thrive, developmental delay, seizures)
cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo full-length (~2.8 kb) antisense SVA with a 20-bp 5' transduction in SRCAP exon 13 caused significant depletion of SRCAP expression and low-level exon skipping in the proband.
cases.quote: RNA sequencing and qRT-PCR confirmed significant depletion of SRCAP expression and low-level exon skipping in the proband.
